findings.detail: AnyNativeFileUploadResponse.finish cancels its URLSessionTask, calls invalidateAndCancel, then immediately resumes the Swift continuation; it does not join a later URLSession completion/invalidation callback. The exact original AnyApplicationSession tracks and drains task.value only. Therefore f731 joining the returned original Swift operation does not itself prove that all transport/server work has stopped before engine/account replacement. Neither the source nor this review demonstrates an actual late write. The retained caller snapshot and original Host reservation prevent automatic same-intent redispatch and noRecorded remains conservative.
